# Traceability

Which tests verify each requirement of [the requirements](requirements.md). A test is evidence
for an ID when its title cites the ID, or when the title of a `describe` block around it does.
Manual checks are the lines of [the manual checks](testing.md#manual-checks) that start with the
ID. Planned and withdrawn IDs are listed only in the requirements.

## Unverified requirements

### Study or measurement

- [PERF-01](requirements.md#perf-01) Event-driven: the design is `src/background/periodic.ts` and `src/content/index.ts`; the targets have not been measured.
- [PERF-02](requirements.md#perf-02) Decision speed: the end-to-end tests check the behaviour with timeouts of a few seconds; the one-second target has not been measured.
- [PERF-03](requirements.md#perf-03) Content scripts where needed: `contentMatches()` in `src/background/contentscripts.ts`; the memory target has not been measured.
- [PERF-05](requirements.md#perf-05) Scale: `compileDnr()` in `src/engine/dnr.ts`; no measurement with 10,000 entries has been made.
- [PERF-06](requirements.md#perf-06) Opening time: not measured.
- [USAB-01](requirements.md#usab-01) First rule in two minutes: no usability test has been run ([roadmap](roadmap.md#verification-debt)).
- [USAB-03](requirements.md#usab-03) SUS score: no usability test has been run.

### Manual check

- [TIM-04](requirements.md#tim-04) Firefox for Android: no check on an Android device has been done.
- [ENF-05](requirements.md#enf-05) Session restore and pinned tabs: `interventionUrl()` in `src/platform/api.ts`; no test restores a browser session.
- [ENF-07](requirements.md#enf-07) Independent of the page: no test covers a page with such handlers.
- [DAT-05](requirements.md#dat-05) Export and import on Android: no check on an Android device has been done.
- [COMP-03](requirements.md#comp-03) Firefox for Android: no check on an Android device has been done.
